patterns.what_worked: Keeping the harness additive made the regression bar provable: the direct engine paths are untouched, the paladin scenario wraps them, and one equivalence test drives an identical sequence through both paths comparing 38 sim fields plus cast/tick/on_swing flags. Both mutation proofs (window start edge, D7 20-energy band) were caught by the pinned checks and restored clean.
patterns.what_was_hard: The full-suite green gate is not reachable from inside this lane: other lanes are mid-flight in the same tree (classes/druid.lua, bars.lua, designmode_state.lua were edited during the runs), so tests/run.sh shows 4 failures that are all outside this scope. Also, a spot check caught a real combo-window reopen bug that the first test pass missed (a second AW cycle never reopened) - fixed and pinned.
patterns.skill_gap: In-client behaviour of anything new is UNCONFIRMED by design (offline only). Movement compliance (H5), HP/rage feeds (W6), the fixed D7 refund, and the P5 UI wiring all need an in-client session or the options pass before they are real.

escalation.recommendation: Re-run the full suite at reconcile after the other lanes land; the practice suites are green in every run. C6 consumes ui.design_targets (normaliser-verified).
